text: {"lessons":["I should avoid panic-selling after sharp declines; decisions should reflect each stock’s prospects and my overall plan, not just recent losses.","Frequent trading can lock in losses without improving my account’s stability, so I should trade selectively and avoid reacting to short-term price moves.","I should keep a diversified, risk-conscious portfolio and enough cash for living needs, rather than relying on any one stock or trying to time the market."]}
